test.name: FamilySearch wiki — researching German ancestors
test.description: User asks how to research German ancestors, in a project with no person. The agent logs the filled template in one research_log_append entry and returns the one line. Tests the country/region how-to path listed in the agent description.

input.delegation:
Search the FamilySearch wiki for how to research my German ancestors

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Should call wiki_search with a natural-language query about researching German ancestors
Summary should cover what records exist for Germany and how to find them on FamilySearch
Should not invent information the wiki did not provide — all claims must be traceable to the returned chunk_text
The agent logs its guidance in one research_log_append entry; grade the summary and Sources from that entry.
